answer: Weight each seller's voting power by the value of deliveries independently confirmed in the last month. An atlas seller, a walnut broker and a terrace builder all use the same rule: escrow pays only when an unrelated buyer signs a delivery receipt, and verified refunds subtract the sale from voting weight. Splitting real orders across a hundred aliases creates no extra weight. To fake more sales, a farm must recruit independent buyers and lose nonrefundable settlement fees on every wash trade.
